meta.title: Act 2 — Sea: The Brine Reach
meta.note: The five main quests of Act 2 (game-story.md §4, issue #144). Act 2 is PART OF THE OPEN WORLD — decided in review of the zone-based first cut of #227: seaward of Embervale's coastline the landform blends into an island sea (terrain.ts SEA_DIR/SEA_START/SEA_FULL), island towns stand past it, and the deep water that refuses you on foot is the act gate. There is no `brine` zone and never will be.
meta.loading: Boot-loaded (see bootstrapContent in main.ts): the islands physically exist from frame 1 because the world is one world, so their settlements must exist when planSettlements runs. What `sea-revealed` opens is the FERRY — the means of crossing — not the geography. The flag-gated loading recorded in issue #209 was a zone-era decision and went with the zone.
meta.the-stub: `quest:sea/salt-and-rope` still ships without its giver or objective triggers; `npc:gain/saltrest` and the ferry-borne talk rows are #152's work. `town:saltrest` is here because the island placer sites it at boot.
